title: Vibe Coding OS Skill Manifest
description: Contract for skills under skills/*/SKILL.md — each skill is a markdown document with a # Name heading and specific sections.

name.description: Skill name extracted from the first `#` heading in the SKILL.md file.

purpose.description: The ## Purpose section — a one-paragraph description of what the skill achieves.

when_to_use.description: The ## When to use section describing triggering conditions.

inputs.description: The ## Inputs section — what information or artifacts this skill needs.

workflow.description: The ## Workflow section, typically a numbered list of steps.

outputs.description: The ## Outputs section describing produced artifacts.

failure_modes.description: The ## Failure modes section documenting common pitfalls.

verification_checklist.description: A list of checkable items from the ## Verification checklist section.

superpowers_alignment.description: Notes on how this skill maps to superpowers-inspired workflow roles.

spec_driven_layer.description: Notes on spec-driven development (github/spec-kit) layer integration.
